Bare text followed by a paragraph inside a blockquote gets a blank-line separator instead of merging into one line

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<blockquote>Just text, then <p>a paragraph</p></blockquote>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
